t.zh: 工作台要能缩放图像。和取出一部分不同，缩放要给新图的每个像素算出一个值；在算值之前，先得知道它落在原图的什么位置。
t.en: The workbench must resize images. Unlike taking out a part, resizing computes a value for every pixel of the new image; before any value, each new pixel needs its position in the original.

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：图像放大或缩小时，新图的每个像素对应原图的什么位置？约定是新旧两排像素的中心对齐，两排一样长。先在格子上手算一行，再搭一块电路。
t.en: This level asks: when an image is enlarged or shrunk, where in the original does each new pixel sit? The convention: the two rows of pixels are equally long and their centres are aligned. First work out one row by hand on the grid, then wire a circuit.

desc.zh: 输入原图的宽 sw、高 sh 和新图的宽 nw、高 nh，输出新图每个像素在原图里的 x、y（两张坐标图）
desc.en: Takes the original's width sw and height sh and the new width nw and height nh; gives each new pixel's x and y in the original (two coordinate images)

after.zh: 这就是<wiki-ref to="sampling-grid"></wiki-ref>：新图的每个像素反向映射回原图。
after.en: This is a <wiki-ref to="sampling-grid"></wiki-ref>: every pixel of the new image mapped back into the original.

brief.zh: 这一行 2 像素宽，放大成 3 像素：写出每个新像素在原图里的 x。
brief.en: This row, 2 pixels wide, is enlarged to 3: write where each new pixel sits in the original, as x.

hint.zh: 把新旧两排画成等长的两条，各自的像素中心落在哪里？
hint.en: Draw the two rows as two bars of one length: where does each pixel centre fall?

after.zh: 新像素不是旧像素换了编号：中间那个落在两个旧像素之间。
after.en: New pixels are not old ones renumbered: the middle one falls between two old pixels.

label.zh: 新像素在原图里的 x

t.zh: 手算一行可以，一整张图就要电路了。新元件：<part-ref to="part:const"></part-ref>、<part-ref to="part:grid"></part-ref>（给定宽高，给出每格就是自己 x、y 的两张图），以及<part-ref to="part:add"></part-ref>、<part-ref to="part:mul"></part-ref>、<part-ref to="part:div"></part-ref>，它们对数和整张图逐个值地算。
t.en: One row by hand is fine; a whole image needs a circuit. New parts: <part-ref to="part:const"></part-ref>, <part-ref to="part:grid"></part-ref> (for a width and height, the two images whose cells hold their own x and y), and <part-ref to="part:add"></part-ref>, <part-ref to="part:mul"></part-ref> and <part-ref to="part:div"></part-ref>, which work value by value on numbers and whole images.

brief.zh: 输入原图和新图的宽高：交出新图每个像素在原图里的 x 坐标图和 y 坐标图。
brief.en: Given the original's and the new width and height, give the image of each new pixel's x in the original, and the image of its y.

hint.zh: 先给新图的每个像素一对它自己的坐标。
hint.en: First give every pixel of the new image its own pair of coordinates.

hint.zh: 新图的一个像素宽，相当于原图的几个像素宽？像素中心和像素左边差多少？
hint.en: One pixel of the new image is how many pixels of the original wide? How far is a pixel's centre from its left edge?
